description: Render a webpage in a headless browser, scroll it from top to bottom while capturing frames, and assemble the frames into an animated GIF.

cookieWindowSelector.description: CSS selector of a cookie-consent dismiss button to click after page load (e.g. button[aria-label="Accept all"]). Skipped if not found.
cookieWindowSelector.title: Cookie consent selector

downscaleFactor.description: Resize each frame down by this integer factor before encoding (1 = no resize, 2 = half, 3 = third). Lower factors → larger but sharper GIF.
downscaleFactor.title: Downscale factor

frameDelayMs.description: Per-frame delay encoded into the GIF.
frameDelayMs.title: Frame delay (ms)

maxFrames.description: Hard cap on frames captured (protects very-long pages from runaway runs).
maxFrames.title: Max frames

scrollStepPx.description: How many pixels to scroll between each captured frame.
scrollStepPx.title: Scroll step (px)

url.description: The URL of the webpage to capture.
url.title: Page URL

waitToLoadPageMs.description: Additional milliseconds to wait after networkidle before capturing the first frame. Use for sites with async/sliding content.
waitToLoadPageMs.title: Extra wait after load (ms)

title: GIF Scroll Animation Input
